comments.author: elliotto
comments.story: Training language models to be warm and empathetic makes them less reliable
comments.why: Shows subtracting the 'low quality video' prompt to improve generation.
comments.text: My favourite instantiation of this weird invocation is from this AI video generator, where they literally subtract the prompt for 'low quality video' from the input, and it improves the quality. [VIDEO] I've just migrated my AI product to a different underlying model and had to redo a few of the prompts that the new model was interpreting differently. It's not obseleted, just requires a bit of migration. The improved quality of the new models outweighs any issues around prompting.
